remarks: Wonderfully updated 2BR 2BA condo unit at Stonewood Condominiums on the second floor. Spacious, open floor plan with great layout and private balcony. Large closet in foyer entry. Updated kitchen with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. Primary bedroom with ensuite bath and walk-in closet with closet organizer, second bedroom with additional full bathroom. Ceiling fans in both bedrooms. 75 Gallon Gas Water Heater. Separate laundry room with full sized washer and dryer. Unit is on the 2nd floor on rear side of the building facing the woods. Enjoy building exercise room and covered parking reserved spot #8. Plenty of unassigned outdoor parking. Great location in West Norwalk, convenient to nearby shopping, restaurants, train and highways!
